verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Fivetran serves a working llms.txt at https://fivetran.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a descriptive summary of the platform, and Fivetran also provides agent-oriented skills/plugins for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI for its Connector SDK. Missing for 10: no full docs.md/markdown mirror of the entire docs site (docs.md returned 404) and no independent third-party confirmation of llms.txt usage by agents in the wild.
